title: Comprehensive Job–Related English
overview: This comprehensive six-month English language program develops the practical communication skills required to perform confidently across diverse professional roles and workplace situations. Participants progressively strengthen listening, speaking, reading and writing, while applying grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation to realistic business tasks. The course integrates everyday professional interaction, written correspondence, meetings, presentations, customer service, technical and administrative communication, and collaborative problem-solving. Learning activities and performance assessments are adapted to participants’ starting proficiency and occupational contexts.
audience: Employees and professionals seeking stronger English for daily job responsibilities.
Administrative, customer-facing, operational and technical staff working in English-speaking environments.
Supervisors, coordinators and team leaders who communicate with colleagues, clients and external stakeholders.
Job seekers and early-career professionals preparing for English-language workplaces.
Learners with foundational English knowledge who wish to progress toward independent professional communication.
methodology: Instructor-led interactive lessons; diagnostic placement and individualized learning goals; workplace dialogues and role-plays; vocabulary and grammar workshops; guided listening and reading; email, report and document-writing practice; meeting and presentation simulations; peer feedback; pronunciation coaching; sector-relevant case studies; digital learning tasks; periodic progress checks and integrated performance assessments.
competencies: Functional workplace fluency and intelligible pronunciation.
Accurate grammar and role-relevant professional vocabulary.
Active listening, clarification and confident interpersonal communication.
Clear professional writing and document comprehension.
Effective participation in meetings, calls and presentations.
Customer and stakeholder communication across routine and challenging situations.
Cross-cultural communication, collaboration and independent language development.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the program, participants will be able to:
objectives: Communicate accurately and confidently in common workplace interactions and job-specific situations.
Understand workplace conversations, instructions, meetings and relevant spoken information.
Read, interpret and summarize emails, policies, procedures, reports and technical or administrative texts.
Write clear emails, messages, reports and other routine business documents using appropriate tone.
Participate constructively in meetings, telephone calls, discussions and professional presentations.
Explain tasks, processes, problems and recommendations using relevant vocabulary and grammatical structures.
Handle customer enquiries, workplace misunderstandings and difficult conversations professionally.
Demonstrate measurable improvement through practical assessments and a personalized development plan.
